<style>
/* ============================================================
   QONJO SECURE LMS — Custom Brand CSS (CORRECTED)
   Targets the REAL Tailwind CSS variables used by Frappe LMS
   Paste this ENTIRE block into: Website Settings → Header, Robots → <head> HTML
   ============================================================ */

/* Load the official Qonjo font */
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap');

/* ── OVERRIDE THE DARK THEME CSS VARIABLES ── */
[data-theme="dark"] {
  /* Sidebar background → Qonjo Navy */
  --surface-sidebar: #0B132B !important;
  
  /* General surface colors */
  --surface-bg: #0F1629 !important;
  --surface-base: #121E3B !important;
  --surface-raised: #192747 !important;
  
  /* Primary action color → Qonjo Blue */
  --primary: #2563EB !important;
  --primary-hover: #1D4ED8 !important;
  --primary-light: rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.15) !important;
  
  /* Text colors */
  --text-base: #F8FAFF !important;
  --text-muted: #CBD5E1 !important;
  --text-light: #94A3B8 !important;
  
  /* Border */
  --border-color: #334155 !important;
  
  /* Links → Qonjo Blue */
  --link-color: #67E8F9 !important;
}

/* ── GLOBAL FONT → Inter ── */
body, *, button, input, textarea, select {
  font-family: 'Inter', 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif !important;
}

/* ── SIDEBAR: Active item → Qonjo Blue ── */
.bg-surface-sidebar [class*="active"],
.bg-surface-sidebar a.router-link-active,
.bg-surface-sidebar .router-link-exact-active {
  background-color: #2563EB !important;
  color: #FFFFFF !important;
  border-radius: 0.375rem !important;
}

/* ── PRIMARY BUTTONS → Qonjo Blue ── */
.bg-primary,
[class*="btn-primary"],
button.btn-primary {
  background-color: #2563EB !important;
  border-color: #2563EB !important;
}

.bg-primary:hover,
[class*="btn-primary"]:hover {
  background-color: #1D4ED8 !important;
  border-color: #1D4ED8 !important;
}

/* ── PROGRESS BARS → Qonjo Gradient ── */
[class*="progress"] > div,
.progress-bar,
[role="progressbar"] {
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, #06B6D4, #2563EB) !important;
}

/* ── NOTIFICATION BADGE → Qonjo Cyan ── */
.bg-red-600,
[class*="notification-count"],
[class*="badge"] {
  background-color: #06B6D4 !important;
  color: #0B132B !important;
}

/* ── STAR RATINGS ── */
.text-yellow-500,
[class*="star"] {
  color: #06B6D4 !important;
}

/* ── SCROLLBAR ── */
::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 6px; }
::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: #0B132B; }
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: #475569; border-radius: 9999px; }
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover { background: #2563EB; }
</style>
name: Website Settings
